observations.driver_gap_caveat: U096 has no public Unit MIC driver: the guest path is machine.ADC on the white analog output plus machine.Pin on the yellow comparator. Acoustic response/threshold/SNR are NOT RUN and are not claimed.

raw_evidence_note: Raw execution artifacts (evidence.zip, frame.png, serial.txt, probe files) stay in the local ignored .work directory; only concise reports, hashes and reproduction commands are committed.
blocker: Guest machine.ADC/machine.Pin path on cores3 (no public Unit MIC driver: explicit driver gap) read adc raw 33832 at the 1600mV analog-mv fixture and comparator level 1; QOM analog-mv=1600, digital-level=true and adc-samples advanced. read_uv() is unavailable because the QEMU S3 ADC calibration eFuse is not burnt (recorded boundary). Acoustic response/threshold potentiometer/sensitivity/SNR/frequency response are NOT RUN.
